Upwelled water
Temperature: typically colder than surface water
Nutrients: typically richer than surface water
Ecological effect: productive coastal food webs

Estuary
Water sources: river water and seawater
Tidal effects: changing depth and chemistry

Counterillumination in midwater animals
Light organs: underside of the body
Light output: matches the brightness of water above
Effect: reduced silhouette when seen from below
provenance: Concise factual data extracted from the cited source. Source: NOAA Ocean Exploration, Ocean Zones curriculum, section 5; https://oceanexplorer.noaa.gov/edu/curriculum/section5.pdf. Consulted 2026-10-13.

Marine bioluminescence
Light source: chemical reactions in living organisms
Functions: communication, prey attraction, disruption of predator attacks
provenance: Concise factual data extracted from the cited source. Source: NOAA National Ocean Service, bioluminescence; https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/biolum.html. Consulted 2026-10-13.
